name: BACH_0099_FSIM_blur3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (79%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Blurred frozen section [F6] includes InSitu [F1]; recuts, deeper levels, and margin deferral drafted [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 79%, InSitu 20%, Benign/Normal 0% | Favors invasive; in situ plausible |
| Conformal set | {InSitu, Invasive} (90% coverage) | Cannot separate Invasive from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability, 100% OOD, flagged | Unreliable input from severe blur |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top classes differ) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 (60%) Invasive, 2/5 InSitu [F5] | Mixed Invasive and InSitu neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (+0.54); 0/20 spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (+0.42); 20/20 spot check [F3] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · High (-0.35); 8/20 spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · High (+0.34); 3/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Low overall (-0.26); 19/20 spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions beats random (+0.0114, CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064); leans on unreliable normal_lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Blur (severity 3, 100% OOD) obscures architecture; recut H&E and deeper levels drafted.
- True class is InSitu (20% probability, conformal set, 78%-similar InSitu case BACH_0077).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 6, 7, 10**: Highest risk (90%–100%); verify invasion versus blur and unreliable necrosis.
2. **Regions 3, 7**: Top validated invasion (0.54, 0.45) and lymphocytes; verify stromal infiltration.
3. **Regions 0, 5**: Lowest risk (6%, 3%); check duct-confined atypia and defer margins.
